text_en: You must be brave to stand before me, witch, after everything you've done to me!
Would you rather have turned to dust and bones?
I would've survived an arrow if you hadn't dragged me here!
If there's one thing that's certain, mortal, it's that our gift makes no mistakes. Calm your rage.
Mistakes like bringing still-living soldiers from Zarga to the afterlife?
Zarga?
Oh... THOSE soldiers...
Tsk...
I have absolutely no idea why they were brought in that state, but it is exactly them I have come to speak to you about.
I don't plan on hanging around here much longer, so be quick.
I have seen the hate you have for them, though you don't have to be particularly observant to notice it, I must say.
I would like to propose an alliance both of us would benefit from.
Go on...
You want to finish them and I want to finish... certain plans.
Why don't you do it yourself? Unlike the others, you seem to take things into your own hands.
How observant you are!
Unfortunately, my enemies have developed a talent for disposing of my minions. I no longer have any use for these parasites.
And I suppose that's where I come in?
With an ally like you, their magic won't save them.
But first, we must do something about your rather limited power.
Grrr... Don't mock me, Valkyrie. Tell me your plan?
Let's just say... You'll be skipping a few lessons ahead.
Pack your bags. We're going to Ragnarok.
Alright, I have nothing left to lose.
That's not the spirit I expected, but it'll do.
We have a pact now, mortal.
Whatever you say...
You won't regret it.
